pr_title: sql/catalog/resolver: return UndefinedDatabase in more cases
pr_body:
In 21.1 and prior, we returned UndefinedDatabase (3D000) in cases where a
table name was used to signify a virtual table and the database did not
exist. It turns out that this behavior was important. It existed for
arbitrary implementation reasons. When that code was refactored
earlier in the 21.2 release, the behavior was removed. Now we restore
that behavior and make the behavior more consistent. When we know that
we're trying to resolve a relation in the current database and we know
that the current database does not exist, we now return the
UndefinedDatabase error.

Fixes https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/71495

Release note (bug fix): In prior betas of 21.2, some error codes returned when
looking for a descriptor in a non-existent database were changed from
UndefinedDatabase (3D000) to UndefinedObject (42704). The behavior has been
reverted and more generally name resolution when the current database is
undefined will return UndefinedDatabase.

issue_context.title: Able to Connect to Non-Existent Databases
issue_context.body:
**Describe the problem**

In the v21.2-beta versions, users are able to connect to non-existent databases and run commands.

**To Reproduce**

1. Open a SQL shell
2. Run `\c nonexistentdb`
3. Run another command like `SELECT * FROM pg_type`

**Expected behavior**
In previous versions, step 2 would raise the following error

```
movr> \c nonexistentdb
ERROR: database "nonexistentdb" does not exist
SQLSTATE: 3D000
```

this is the output in v21.2

```
movr> \c nonexistentdb
using new connection URL: postgresql://root@ipaddr/nonexistentdb?sslmode=disable
warning: unable to retrieve the server's version: pq: database "nonexistentdb" does not exist
# Client version: CockroachDB CCL v21.2.0-alpha.00000000-4900-g1cb0151eee (x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu, built 2021/10/11 20:41:17, go1.16.6)
# Server version: CockroachDB CCL v21.2.0-alpha.00000000-4900-g1cb0151eee (x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu, built 2021/10/11 20:41:17, go1.16.6)
warning: error retrieving the transaction status: the cluster ID has changed!
Previous ID: 72c351df-8ea3-4d3a-a539-90b6dc197e55
New ID: 
warning: unable to retrieve the server's version: pq: database "nonexistentdb" does not exist
warning: error retrieving the database name: pq: database "nonexistentdb" does not exist
?> SELECT * FROM pg_type;
ERROR: relation "pg_type" does not exist
SQLSTATE: 42P01
warning: error retrieving the database name: pq: database "nonexistentdb" does not exist
```

It appears that the error has been turned into a warning instead.

**Environment:**
 - CockroachDB version: v21.2.0-alpha.00000000-4900-g1cb0151eee (x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu, built 2021/10/11 20:41:17, go1.16.6)
 - Server OS: Linux/Ubuntu

**Additional context**
This was discovered during ActiveRecord testing on a test to check if a database exists.
